A DSpark draft model adds speculative decoding to LFM2.5-VL-3B:
faster generation, the same outputs, a small memory cost.
• An experimental DSpark draft model adds speculative decoding
to Liquid AI's LFM2.5-VL-3B without changing output quality.
• Decoding runs up to 3.13x faster on device and 2.66x on an
• The 280M-parameter drafter adds 8.9% to the 3B model and has
day-one support in llama.cpp, MLX-VLM and SGLang.
· The drafter conditions on the target's hidden states, so
images and text use the same algorithm as the text drafters.
· Only decoding speeds up, not vision encoding or prefill, so
end-to-end gains are smaller where prefill dominates.
· Output is exact: the target verifies every drafted token.
decoding path that trades a minimal increase in memory
footprint for a larger speedup without changing output
